title: The Kindly Winter
author: Astrid Fairweather
blurb: Juniper Fairweather, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
